title: Add Jev Assembler to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Jev Assembler](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-jev-assembler) to build
- Describe a page in a sentence. Jev makes 16 small decisions about it in a single POST /alpha/decisions call (palette, typography, layout, call to action, roundness, density, urgency, and which section

Fixes #15741, fixes #15722

gist.headline: Sixteen decisions, one sentence
gist.blurb: Jev Assembler joins the app collection. Give it a sentence about a page, and it works through 16 little design decisions. The indecisive among us may feel seen.
gist.summary: Jev Assembler is added to the app collection; it turns a one-sentence page description into 16 design decisions through a single POST /alpha/decisions call, covering palette, typography, layout, call to action, roundness, density, and urgency.
gist.impact: Page builders get a starting set of 16 design choices from one sentence and one API call.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Jev Assembler as a friendly pixel-art page-building workbench: one sentence on a note flows into 16 small design tiles for colors, type, and layout. Polli helps arrange the tiles into a budding webpage; avoid inventing a mascot or logo for Jev.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workshop, Polli in a tiny tool belt arranges 16 little design tiles around a budding webpage, with a handwritten sentence feeding into the workbench and lime green (#ecf874) code-plants growing beside it. Polli is a cute small-to-medium pixel art bee with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, a small happy smile, and small rounded translucent light-blue wings; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients on a warm cream background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
